name: Three-knob overdrive
blurb: A TL072 op-amp overdrive with soft diode clipping, a treble-cut tone control and a volume, on a single 9 V supply with a 4.5 V bias. The board the tutorial builds.

name: Tight Boost
blurb: An input buffer, a TIGHT low cut from 30 to 340 Hz and a Tube Screamer style stage with its 720 Hz mid hump. Drive down, level up, in front of a high-gain amp.

name: Noise Gate (4-cable)
blurb: Keyed from the guitar, gating the amp's effects loop: a precision envelope detector, a comparator with hysteresis and a J201 shunt gate that opens in under 1 ms. Works as a 2-jack gate too.

name: High-Gain Distortion
blurb: Two cascaded hard-clipping op-amp stages with a tight low-end pre-emphasis, an amp-style bass, middle and treble stack, and a recovery stage.

name: Tweed Champ 5 W
open: Amp › Open example amp › Tweed Champ 5 W single-ended
blurb: The simplest tube amp there is: two gain stages into a single-ended 6V6 with cathode bias and a tube rectifier. Breaks up early and sweetly.

name: EL84 18 W push-pull
open: Amp › Open example amp › EL84 18 W push-pull
blurb: Two gain stages and a DC-coupled cathode follower into a Marshall-style tone stack, a cathodyne phase inverter and a cathode-biased EL84 pair.

name: Plexi crunch 50 W
open: Amp › Open example amp › Plexi crunch 50 W
blurb: Made with the Amp Designer: bright, punchy British crunch with a cathode follower, the Marshall tone stack, presence, a master volume and a fixed-bias EL34 pair.

name: Modern high gain 50 W
open: Amp › Open example amp › Modern high gain 50 W
blurb: Made with the Amp Designer: a four-stage preamp with a cold clipper, a post-distortion tone stack, depth and presence, and a tube-buffered effects loop.

name: Extreme high gain 100 W
open: Amp › Open example amp › Extreme high gain 100 W
blurb: Made with the Amp Designer: five cascaded stages, a deeply scooped EQ with a 10k middle control, a tight low end, DC heaters and four 6L6GCs.

name: LM3886 bass amp 50 W
open: Amp › Open example amp › LM3886 bass amp 50 W
blurb: A solid-state bass amp: a TL072 preamp with a Bassman-style tone stack and recovery stage, an impedance-balanced XLR DI, and an LM3886 on ±30 V rails into speakON.

name: 555 LED flasher
blurb: An NE555 astable flashing a red LED at about 1.5 Hz, with a reset button. Press F5 and it blinks; double-click a net to watch it on the oscilloscope.
